results.releaseNotes:
● NEW: Calendar & Events - Manage your calendar from your computer

View, create, edit, and delete events in month, week, or day views. Access all your iPhone calendars, set event details, locations, and notes. All changes sync instantly with your iPhone calendar. Enable the Calendar feature in Settings for secure access (off by default).

● Photo Browser - Browse and download your iPhone photos from your computer

Access your photo library wirelessly from the web interface. Browse albums, view thumbnails and full-resolution images, and download photos to your computer. Choose download size (original, large, medium, small) and format (JPEG/PNG). Videos are supported too—watch in the browser or download. Filter by album and date, use the lightbox for full-screen preview. Enable the Photo Browser in Settings for secure access (off by default).

● Voice-to-Text - Dictate messages using your iPhone's microphone

Speak your messages naturally and watch them appear in real-time on your computer. Your iPhone acts as the microphone, so you can dictate from anywhere in the room. Choose from over 100 supported languages, and switch languages even while recording. Perfect for hands-free messaging and multilingual conversations.

● Contact Management - View, edit, and manage your iPhone contacts from your computer

Manage all your contacts directly from the web interface: search, add, edit, delete, and update contact photos. All changes sync instantly with your iPhone address book. Enable this feature in Settings for secure access.

Thank you for all your feedback! If you miss something, don't hesitate to contact us.
Do you like the app? Please leave a review in the app store.
results.description:
Access your iPhone photos, contacts, and messages from any web browser. Full control of your iPhone data from your Mac or PC.

Tired of being tethered to your iPhone screen? Get complete web-based access to your photos, contacts, and text messages - all from the comfort of your computer's browser with a real keyboard.

Photo Library Access
---------------------------
▶ Browse your entire iPhone photo library from any web browser: view albums, thumbnails, and full-resolution images. Download photos and videos with custom size and format options (JPEG/PNG). Filter by album and date. Your photos, accessible anywhere.

Contact Management
---------------------------
▶ Full web-based access to your iPhone contacts: view, search, add, edit, and delete contacts directly from your browser. Update contact photos with an easy-to-use cropping tool. All changes sync instantly with your iPhone. Export all your contacts to CSV.

SMS & Email from Your Browser
---------------------------
▶ Compose and send text messages and emails using your computer's keyboard through your web browser. Access your full address book - no typing phone numbers or email addresses. Send to multiple recipients. No character limit, with message count display for fee control.

Your iPhone data is just a browser away. Connect via WiFi and manage everything from your computer.

Note: WiFi connection required. SMS sent via your iPhone - standard carrier fees apply.
